signatures: def execute(sql: str, tables: dict) -> tinyq.schema.Table
notes: tables maps table name -> tinyq.schema.Table. Pipeline order: FROM, WHERE, GROUP BY + aggregates, projection, ORDER BY, LIMIT. SELECT * returns the source columns unchanged (names and kinds preserved). Aggregate output column is named by the parser alias, default f'{func}({arg})'. A bare aggregate with no GROUP BY yields exactly one row, even over an empty table (COUNT->0, SUM->0, AVG/MIN/MAX->None); GROUP BY over an empty table yields zero rows. Group keys keep the source column kind; aggregate columns get a kind inferred from the computed values. ORDER BY sorts None last on ascending and is stable across multiple keys (later keys break ties of earlier ones), falling back to string comparison for mixed-type columns. LIMIT >= nrows is a no-op. Errors: unknown table name raises KeyError(name); unknown column raises KeyError from Table.column/predicate; SELECT * with GROUP BY raises ValueError; a non-aggregated select column absent from GROUP BY raises ValueError; ORDER BY on a column not in the result raises ValueError; negative LIMIT raises ValueError; malformed SQL propagates ValueError from tinyq.parser.parse.
